summaryZh: NEATLabs 研究全生命周期中的神经认知回路，利用神经工程刺激目标回路可塑性并改变行为。研究同时使用动物模型和人类研究，开发结合移动认知评估与无线 EEG 的 BrainE 平台。
researchQuestions: 精神神经障碍如何影响认知行为所依赖的神经回路？
在创伤性脑损伤和精神分裂症的啮齿类动物模型中，遗传和／或环境扰动如何导致特定认知损伤？
神经、认知和心理健康因素如何与多样的环境挑战相互作用？

evidence.quote: Neural Engineering and Translation Labs aim to advance the understanding of neuro-cognitive circuits across the lifespan. We apply neural engineering methods in both animal models and human research to stimulate brain plasticity in target circuits and change behavior.
the Brain Engagement platform ( BrainE for short) that deploys rapid, mobile cognitive assessments with wireless electroencephalography (EEG).
Department of Psychiatry Department of Psychiatry UC San Diego School of Medicine
Neural Engineering and Translation Labs (NEATLABS) -- Jyoti Mishra Ramanathan, PhD & Dhakshin Ramanathan, MD, PhD
To better understand how neural circuits underlying cognitive behaviors are impacted in neuropsychiatric disorders.

Our animal studies are currently examining rodent models of traumatic brain Injury and schizophrenia to understand how genetic and/or environmental perturbations result in specific cognitive impairments.
to better understand how neural, cognitive and mental health factors interact with diverse environmental challenges
